tax.text: Valadao voted for the 2025 One Big Beautiful Bill Act extending and expanding the 2017 tax cuts, touting lower taxes for families.
tax.quote: These are real wins that will put more money back in the pockets of hardworking Central Valley families.

trade.text: Valadao led a bipartisan effort to eliminate Japanese tariffs on frozen blueberries exported from the United States.
trade.quote: U.S. frozen blueberries receive the same duty-free market access in Japan as fresh or dried blueberries, as well as other frozen berries

debt.text: His campaign says the nation's finances require reexamining the future of Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: Our nation's financial situation requires that we carefully examine the future of programs our seniors depend upon like Medicare and Social Security.

housing.text: Valadao supported federal housing legislation and secured funding to construct 36 affordable senior-housing units in Bakersfield.
housing.quote: Improving affordability is one of my top priorities, which is why I was proud to support bills like the Housing for the 21st Century Act

safety.text: Valadao co-sponsored legislation funding training, safety resources and mental-health services for small police departments.
safety.quote: We must increase our investment in public safety and make sure our existing law enforcement officers know they have our support.

immigration.text: Valadao backs both tougher border security and protections and legal status for Dreamers and farm workers, a mixed stance.
immigration.quote: I am proud to protect our Dreamers. My Congressional District is home to more than 7,000 DACA recipients.

guns.text: Valadao voted against expanding background checks and backs concealed-carry reciprocity, opposing new gun restrictions.
guns.quote: Voted NO on background checks for private transfers.

health.text: Valadao favors market-based competition in health care and has voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act.
health.quote: Market-based competition is best health care solution

energy.text: His campaign blames regulation and litigation for blocking energy development and raising costs, favoring more domestic production.
energy.quote: red tape and frivolous litigation is blocking the development of America's energy resources, killing jobs and slamming families with sky-high energy costs.

voting.text: Valadao supports requiring citizenship documentation for federal voter registration and identification with mail ballots.
voting.quote: This bill simply requires that states obtain proof of an individual’s citizenship status when they register to vote in federal elections.

tax.text: Villegas calls for raising government revenue by taxing the wealthiest to fund breaks and services for working families.
tax.quote: The most effective and fair way to increase government revenue is to tax the top 1% of income earners and wealth holders, and give working families the break we've earned.

wages.text: He argues the federal minimum wage should be far higher, noting it would be $25 an hour if it had tracked productivity.
wages.quote: if the minimum wage kept up with worker productivity over the past 50 years, it would be $25 an hour. Instead, it's just $7.25.

trade.text: He criticizes tariffs for harming Central Valley farmers and small businesses.
trade.quote: But angering our trading partners with frivolous tariffs has killed the revenue of farmers, and small businesses across the country.

debt.text: Under a section titled 'Protect Social Security,' he stresses safeguarding seniors' fixed incomes against inflation.
debt.quote: Ask someone with a fixed Social Security income and they'll tell you: their check doesn't go as far as it used to.

housing.text: He backs a large federal program to build a large amount of new affordable housing nationwide.
housing.quote: We need an ambitious federal program to build an abundance of affordable and safe housing across the country, creating hundreds of thousands of well-paid union jobs in the process.

schools.text: He emphasizes investing in public school teachers, staff, and smaller class sizes.
schools.quote: Teachers and education staff deserve salaries they can plan for a future with, and classroom sizes small enough to steward every child's development.

immigration.text: He supports a path to citizenship for undocumented immigrants and opposes blanket detention and deportation.
immigration.quote: We need a working system that protects our communities while providing a path to citizenship so our undocumented neighbors, friends and coworkers aren't forced to live in the shadows.

guns.text: He supports gun-safety measures intended to prevent violence and keep dangerous weapons from people who should not have them.
guns.quote: That is why he supports commonsense gun safety measures that can help prevent violence before it happens and keep dangerous weapons out of the wrong hands.

health.text: He calls healthcare a human right and is a strong supporter of Medicare for All.
health.quote: I believe healthcare is a human right, and am a strong supporter of Medicare for All.

energy.text: He warns that worsening climate change threatens food, water, and livable temperatures and calls for action.
energy.quote: We're seeing record heat, year after year. If nothing changes, our food, water, and livable temperatures are all at risk.
